text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-20260303-1723 — latency tail breach (p95 up 2.8x, p99 up 4.1x) on prod-inference-route-east. Trigger: service.latency > 250ms for 5m. Link: https://pagerduty.internal/incidents/INC-20260303-1723
eli: acked on-call, I'm taking initial triage :hand: 
pagerduty: Incident INC-20260303-1723 acknowledged by eli
ajay: seeing KV cache evictions on the hot path (model-pool-2). Hotkey concentration ~ 12% of traffic, retries climbing. Doing quick cache warm.
maria: I can shift traffic to fallback-quantized for a short window. Recommend gradual 2-step reroute.
eli: please proceed. Plan: 40% -> 80% fallback over 60s, monitor p95 and queue depth. Use admin reroute and post confirmation here.
leo: quick logs dump — sidecar + router lines:
```
[2026-03-03T17:21:05Z] router    p95=312ms p99=742ms requests=1200 q_depth=48
[2026-03-03T17:21:12Z] sidecar   cpu=98% kv_evictions=234 inflight=56
[2026-03-03T17:22:05Z] router    p95=338ms p99=815ms requests=1400 q_depth=62
```
ajay: executing reroute now: `curl -s -X POST https://console.internal/admin/reroute -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"fallback-quant","weight":40,"step_seconds":60}'`
ops-runner: reroute accepted, rollout started -> current weight fallback=40% (step 1).
maria: metrics: p95 dipped to 245ms after 45s, queue depth 28. still monitoring :eyes: 
eli: push second step to 80% now if stable.
ajay: applying second step: `-d '{"weight":80}'` -> applied.
ops-runner: rollout complete -> fallback weight=80%
maria: visible improvement: p95=198ms, p99=420ms, errors unchanged.
eli: updating PD incident notes: "mitigated by traffic reroute to fallback-quantized model; continued monitoring. No customer-facing errors observed."
pagerduty: Secondary escalation notified: maria
maria: running `/runbook latency-tail` checklist and capturing timeline + CI logs for RCA.
ajay: kicking off async cache warm job (job id 4821) to refill hot keys.
eli: holding incident open for 1h stabilization. If p95 < 250ms and q_depth < 10 for 30m we close.
leo: noting an anomalous sidecar CPU spike correlated with a large request fanout from a single client pool — flagged for follow-up.
maria: assigning RCA owner: ajay. Follow-up ticket created: SRE-6082.
eli: thanks team — good quick response. Will post postmortem template and close PD when stable.
